obs_layout: 13 q (ACT_J order, rad, q = jointAngle), 13 qd*0.1 (rad/s), chest world angle, pelvis world angle (rad, CCW +), chest angvel*0.1, pelvis angvel*0.1 (rad/s), chest centre height above ground + 0.02 skin (m), pelvis centre vx, vz (m/s), paw contact fr fl rr rl (0/1), previous RAW action 13 (clipped, before the low-pass), v_cmd (m/s, ramped 0.5 m/s^2, 0 while standing), sin(2 pi tc/T), cos(2 pi tc/T) (tc held at 0 while v_cmd == 0); see unity-transfer-dog.md section 1
act_layout: 13 target offsets in [-1,1] (ACT_J order): q_target = base + a_filtered * span; base = stand pose blended into the game-trot reference; paws: base keeps the paw flat; see unity-transfer-dog.md section 2
